official_reference.title: ECG-FM: An Open Electrocardiogram Foundation Model
official_reference.authors: K. McKeen, S. Masood, A. Toma, B. Rubin, and B. Wang

evidence: Model architecture name: 'wav2vec2_cmsc' (Wav2Vec2CMSCModel self-supervised pretraining backbone)
No downstream linear classification head present in model state dictionary (state dict contains CMSC and wav2vec 2.0 pretraining heads)

verdict_rationale: The candidate checkpoint 'checkpoints/ecg_fm/mimic_iv_ecg_physionet_pretrained.pt' is conclusively verified as the official pretrained ECG-FM model released by Wang Lab. It is bit-for-bit cryptographically identical to the Hugging Face Git LFS release (SHA-256: 4d0142bcb485eb9f0c7845e0c19ff3463f6ae9d0e458eab69136efe90ceb9b7e), matches the publication's wav2vec2_cmsc architecture (90,883,072 parameters, 12 layers, 768 hidden dim), loads cleanly with strict=True, and deterministically outputs standardized 768-dimensional representations.
